ideas.title: +1 Mech Height
ideas.hook: Every step you take bolts one more block onto your mech. Walk long enough and you tower over the whole map.
core_loop: Walk to stack +1 height onto your mech
Stomp through gated zones only tall mechs can step over
Collect scrap to buy stronger legs and arms
Rebirth into a new mech frame with a height multiplier
ideas.twist: Taller mechs get slower and wobblier, so players pick between a skyscraper that barely moves and a short, fast sprinter for timed zones.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is up 1.86x (+1 Stone Skipping 25.8K CCU, +1 Assassin Leveling 12.4K) and "+1 ___" titles rise 1.99x. +1 × Robots / mechs is an open gap (3.58) while robot games are up 1.37x (WRONG WAY! 4.1K, RoChess! 2.7K).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow a number on a noob; here the stat is physical, and the mech you build visibly fills the screen.

ideas.title: Restore Fossils for Gems
ideas.hook: Dig up a crusty fossil, brush and paint it back to life, and put it in your museum. The better the restoration, the more visitors pay.
core_loop: Dig a dirty fossil from the quarry
Brush, glue and paint it on your workbench
Display it in your museum for gems per second
Spend gems on bigger digs and rarer bones
ideas.twist: Finished skeletons wake up at night and roam the museum, and a fully restored set unlocks a rideable dino.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.08x (Kukirin Life 25.8K, Paint a Pancake 4.5K) and Dinosaurs up 1.73x (Ride a Dino 14.2K, Prehistoric Farm 4.0K). Paint × Dinosaurs is a 4.97 gap, and restore-it ASMR is the newcomer look in shop games (Rust Blaster, Fix My Phone!). "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.52x.
ideas.differentiator: Dino games let you ride or farm dinos; here you rebuild them bone by bone, and the satisfying clean-up is the core loop.

ideas.title: +1 Tail Whip
ideas.hook: You are a baby dino and meteors keep falling. Every tail swing gives +1 power, and you whip the meteors as far as you can.
core_loop: Swing your tail to gain +1 whip power
Smack incoming meteors for distance
Cash in distance for eggs of bigger dino species
Evolve into a bigger dino with a stronger base whip
ideas.twist: Some meteors hatch a rare dino egg if you whip them into the volcano zone instead of for distance.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is up 1.89x (Cat Battles 26.5K, +1 Stone Skipping 25.8K) and Dinosaurs up 1.73x (Ride a Dino 14.2K). Hit × Dinosaurs is an open gap (4.52) and "+1 ___" titles rise 1.99x.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games swing a bat or a pickaxe; here your dino's own tail is the bat and evolving the dino is the upgrade path.

ideas.title: Stylists vs Slobs
ideas.hook: Waves of badly dressed slobs are marching onto your runway. Place stylist towers that restyle them before they ruin the show.
core_loop: Place stylist towers along the catwalk path
Restyle each wave with makeup, hair and outfit blasts
Earn tickets from the cheering crowd
Unlock rarer stylists and runway themes
ideas.twist: Restyled slobs join your show as models, so a clean wave makes the crowd bigger and the next wave pays more.
ideas.why_now: Tower defense is up 1.71x (Cameraman Tower Defense 31.7K, Bunker vs Verity 20.1K) and Fashion / beauty up 1.73x (Facecard: Makeup Showdown 21.1K, Makeup Salon 5.3K). TD × Fashion is a 4.72 gap and "___ vs ___" titles rise 1.21x.
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games are judged dress-up rounds; this turns styling into the attack, so fashion fans get a strategy game.

ideas.title: Build a Hero Suit
ideas.hook: Draw your own superhero suit on a blank mannequin. The colours and symbols you paint decide your powers, then you take it into the arena.
core_loop: Paint a suit, cape and emblem in the studio
See which powers your design rolled
Fight other players' heroes in the arena
Win ink and fabric to unlock new colours and power slots
ideas.twist: Red paint adds fire, blue adds ice, lightning bolts add speed, so players copy and trade winning suit designs.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is up 2.08x (Kukirin Life 25.8K, Paint to Get Rich 14.0K) and Superheroes up 1.29x (Superhero Arena 9.2K). Paint × Superheroes is a 4.19 gap, and the newer draw-to-fight game DRAW SPELLS MAGIC ARENA is at 2.7K. "Build a ___" titles rise 1.19x.
ideas.differentiator: Hero battlegrounds hand you preset heroes; here the hero is your drawing, so no two fighters look or play the same.

ideas.title: Forge Gadgets for Heroes
ideas.hook: Run the gadget shop superheroes rely on. Build grappling hooks, jetpacks and power gloves, then watch your customers use them in city fights.
core_loop: Take orders from heroes at the counter
Craft the gadget on your workbench
Sell it and watch the hero fight with it outside
Upgrade benches and hire helpers to fill orders faster
ideas.twist: If a hero loses a fight with your gadget, they come back angry for a refund, so quality matters as much as speed.
retention: Daily villain attack on the city
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is up 1.80x (Sell Fries! 41.2K, Make Rugs! 6.9K) and Superheroes up 1.29x (Superhero Arena 9.2K). Shop × Superheroes is an open gap (3.63) and Interiors maps are rising 1.95x.
ideas.differentiator: Hero games put you in the cape; this puts you behind the counter, and every sale shows up in the fight outside.

ideas.title: Bass vs Ghosts
ideas.hook: Ghosts are crashing your Halloween party. Set up speakers, drums and DJ decks that blast them back with sound waves.
core_loop: Place speaker towers along the haunted path
Drop the beat to power up your towers
Clear waves for vinyl coins
Unlock bigger speakers and new music genres
ideas.twist: Towers hit harder when players tap in rhythm, so a good beat doubles damage for the whole team.
ideas.why_now: Tower defense is up 1.71x (Cameraman Tower Defense 31.7K, Bunker vs Verity 20.1K) and Music / dance up 1.45x (Trending Emote Dance 6.5K, Piano Rhythm Tiles 4.4K). TD × Music is a 3.62 gap and "___ vs ___" titles rise 1.21x.
ideas.differentiator: TD games are about armies and anime units; here the towers are a sound system and your rhythm powers them.

ideas.title: Blast Tombs for Relics
ideas.hook: Sandblast your way through sealed tomb walls and watch hidden relics appear under the sand.
core_loop: Blast through a tomb wall layer by layer
Uncover relics and add them to your index
Sell duplicates for gold
Upgrade your blaster to reach deeper chambers
ideas.twist: Some walls hide cursed relics that awaken a mummy chase, and surviving it doubles the haul.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is the top rising mechanic at 3.00x (Break and Steal an Egg 162.9K, Dig For Eggs 7.5K) and Collect / index is up 1.97x. Collect × Ancient is an open gap (3.71) and Build the Pyramid! holds 6.9K. "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.52x.
ideas.differentiator: Dig games smash blocks for eggs; this one is a slow, satisfying reveal where the blast shows the treasure taking shape.

ideas.title: Polish Rocks for Cash
ideas.hook: Pick up dull rocks, drop them in your tumbler, and pull out shiny gems to sell at your stand.
core_loop: Collect plain rocks around the riverbed
Tumble and polish them into gems
Sell gems at your roadside stand
Buy bigger tumblers that run while you are away
ideas.twist: You never know what's inside until it's polished, and every so often a plain rock comes out as a rare geode.
ideas.why_now: Stones / rocks / ores is the top rising theme at 2.11x (+1 Stone Skipping 25.8K, Lift Rock For Eggs 9.5K) and Sell / run a shop is up 1.80x (Make Rugs! 6.9K). Idle is the fastest rising subgenre at 1.97x (Don't Miss Your Flight! 15.7K) and "___ for ___" titles lead at 3.52x.
ideas.differentiator: Rock games are about lifting or throwing rocks for stats; this is a calm ASMR shop where the rock itself turns into the prize.

ideas.title: Catapult vs Castle
ideas.hook: One team builds a castle, the other team builds a catapult. Then the stones fly and the walls crumble with real physics.
core_loop: Build your side in a timed build phase
Launch stones or patch walls during the siege
Earn gold for every block smashed or saved
Unlock new ammo, wall materials and siege engines
ideas.twist: Teams swap sides each round, so the best builders learn from how their own castle fell.
retention: Replay of the best crumble each day
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is up 1.89x (Cat Battles 26.5K) and Physics Sim is rising 1.59x (Realistic Phone Drop Test 9.2K, Ragdoll Engine 6.9K). Fantasy / medieval is up 1.32x (Pixel Lineage 7.4K), Low poly art is rising 1.79x and "___ vs ___" titles rise 1.21x (Bunker vs Verity 20.1K).
ideas.differentiator: Physics games destroy things alone; this makes the destruction a team match with a build phase and a defend phase.
